newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Bakrie Brothers prices and raises FRN.
newsitem.headline: Bakrie Brothers prices and raises FRN.

text.p: The following issue has been priced and increased to US$175 million from US$100 million, lead manager Peregrine Fixed Income said on Wednesday.
The issue was launched on September 18 with an indicative spread of 200 to 225 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate. It was priced today at LIBOR plus 220 basis points.
Details are as follows:
